notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Repeat.
